question: Where is Indira Gandhi Institute of Development Research (IGIDR) situated?
solution:
The correct answer is **Mumbai**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Location:** Indira Gandhi Institute of Development Research (IGIDR) is located in **Mumbai**, Maharashtra.
 
• **Establishment:** It was established by the Reserve Bank of India in 1987.
 
• **Objective:** The institute's primary objective is to carry out research on developmental issues from a multi-disciplinary point of view.
 
• **Academic Programs:** IGIDR offers M.Sc. and Ph.D. programs in Development Studies.
 
• **Campus:** The campus is spread over 14 acres and provides various facilities including a library, computer center, and residential quarters.
